mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.0: Brrup! Rain is just the sky saying hello.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.1: Ribbit. You look dry. Are you all right?
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.2: The pond is warm today. The pond is always warm. Ribbit.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.3: Mushrooms, music, mud. What else is there?
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.4: Have you tried sitting very still on a lily pad? Life changing. Brrup.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.5: We had a dance last night. You should have come. Ribbit.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.6: Hop hop. Sorry. It just happens.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.7: Flies taste better in the evening. Don't ask how I know.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.home.0: Welcome to %1$s! Mind the puddles. Actually, enjoy the puddles.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.home.1: Brrup! %1$s is the dampest place for a day's hop. We're very proud.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.home.2: Everyone in %1$s plays something. I play the waiting game. Ribbit.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.rain.1: Stand in it with me. Go on. Ribbit.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.rain.2: The sky is wet and so am I. Perfect.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.thunder.0: The sky drums louder than our band. Show-off.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.thunder.1: Brrup. Thunder makes my throat tickle.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.clear.0: Too sunny. My skin feels like old bread.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.clear.1: A dry day. I shall sit in the pond until it is over.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.night.0: The moon is out. The moon is a big round lily pad. Ribbit.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.night.1: Night is for music and crickets. Mostly crickets.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.dawn.0: Morning dew! Free baths for everyone!
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.hot.0: Hot, hot. I'm going in the water. Bye. Ribbit.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fluff.cold.0: Cold makes me slow. Very... slow... brrup.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.state.asleep.2: Zzz... the lily pad is mine... zzz
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.state.busy.0: One frog at a time, please. Ribbit.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.mood.liked.0: You! Brrup! Our favourite dry friend!
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.mood.liked.1: Ribbit! The pond likes you. So do I.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.mood.liked.2: You came back! Have a mushroom. Not that one.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.mood.disliked.0: Hmph. You. The sorcerers have been muttering about you.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.mood.disliked.1: Keep away from the pond, you. Ribbit.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.mood.disliked.2: We don't sing for you. Not anymore.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.mood.raid.0: Hide! Hide in the reeds! Brrup!
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.mood.raid.1: Monsters at the pond! Somebody play something scary!
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.mood.afraid.0: After the trouble, nobody sings at night.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.mood.afraid.1: I sleep under the water now. Safer.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.mood.uneasy.0: The pond is quiet. Too quiet. Ribbit.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.mood.uneasy.1: We had a fright not long ago. Our toes are still curled.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.mood.monsters.0: Something squelches out there. Not one of us.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.mood.monsters.1: Shh. Things in the dark. Big things.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.mood.hungry.0: The flies are thin this week. So are we.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.news.assault.us.0: Somebody hurt one of us %3$s. %1$s, they say. Not nice.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.news.assault.us.1: %1$s came at us %3$s. We still talk about it.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.news.robbery.us.0: Our amethyst went missing %3$s. %1$s, I think.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.news.robbery.us.1: We were robbed %3$s. %1$s took the shiny things.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.news.trade.us.0: %1$s trades fair with us. The merchant says so. Ribbit!
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.news.trade.you.0: You traded fair with %2$s %3$s. Word gets around. Ribbit!
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.news.rescue.us.0: %1$s saved us %3$s! I wrote a song. It is mostly croaking.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.news.rescue.you.0: You saved %2$s %3$s! I wrote a song about it. It is mostly croaking.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.gardener.fluff.0: Toadstools! Big red ones! I grew them myself.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.gardener.fluff.1: Plants like rain and so do I. We are very alike.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.gardener.fluff.2: Don't step on the moss. The moss has feelings. Probably.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.gardener.fluff.3: Swamp daisies are the prettiest flower. Fight me. Gently.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fisherman.fluff.0: The fish are biting. Me too, sometimes.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fisherman.fluff.1: Lily pads are the best boats. Free and they float. Ribbit.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fisherman.fluff.2: I caught a boot once. I live in it now.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.fisherman.fluff.3: Ponds are just puddles that tried harder.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.merchant.fluff.0: Amethyst, amethyst. Shiny and sings when you tap it. Ribbit.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.merchant.fluff.1: Prices are fair. Fair for me. Brrup.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.merchant.fluff.2: I count my amethyst every night. Thirty-two. Thirty-three? Again.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.merchant.fluff.3: Want to buy something? Everyone wants to buy something.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.sorcerer.fluff.0: The moon whispers to the pond. The pond whispers to me. Today it said: buy more mushrooms.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.sorcerer.fluff.1: I see your future. It is damp.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.sorcerer.fluff.2: Magic is just rain that remembers. Ribbit.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.sorcerer.fluff.3: The stars croak, if you listen with your whole belly.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.sorcerer.mood.like: The pond spirits smile on you. I shall bless your feet.
You are in the stars' good books. And mine. Brrup.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.sorcerer.mood.disl: The spirits frown at your name. No blessings for you.
I have seen your shadow in the water. It was rude.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.musician.fluff.0: Bass, bongo, flute, guitar. I am the one who keeps time.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.musician.fluff.1: We play where the master goes. Today it was a puddle. Good acoustics.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.musician.fluff.2: A band is friends who agree on a rhythm. Mostly. Ribbit.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.nitwit.fluff.0: Hmm hmm hmm. Hmmmm. That's the song.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.nitwit.fluff.1: Do you know any songs? I know one. Hmm hmm.
mic_rtsim.talk.ribbit.nitwit.fluff.2: I'm in a band! I play the waiting-for-my-turn.
